title: Dated sweep of all 9 no-betting-line fixtures: no two-sided price found; HLTV readable from the sandbox client but priceless by design
detail: On 2026-10-23T06:20Z-07:05Z (live snapshot generated_at 2026-10-23T06:17:47Z) every active fixture carrying only a research-model pick (9) was re-checked: HLTV first, then the bo3.gg/Thunderpick relay and Polymarket's event API. Polymarket event 1238706 (Infinite-BRUTE) shows a 0.92-spread 0.04/0.96 book and event 1237427 (Ground Zero-Off Chops) a 0.87-spread 0.06/0.93 book; no Polymarket event exists for Phantom Academy vs Banda chuya. No probability, pick or alias changed. A later market can still close these rows on the next four-hour refresh.
